# Onus Wood

> Australian timber lighting, made to order: pendants, wall sconces, floor lamps, task lamps and candelabras in a choice of Australian hardwoods. Prices in AUD including GST.

## Pieces
- [Cradle pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/cradle-pendant/): A shallow timber dome built from six wide segments, with the seams left on show and a warm pool of light beneath. From $1,480.
- [Daintree pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/daintree-pendant/): A tall timber cylinder of five curved staves, with light escaping through narrow vertical slots. From $2,280.
- [Flinders pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/flinders-pendant/): A small timber box pendant, its four sides held together with bead-blasted aluminium dovetail keys, open at the base. From $1,240.
- [Wollemi wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/wollemi-wall-sconce/): A linen drum shade on a slim timber arm, pivoting on a satin aluminium ball joint from a turned timber backplate. From $640.
- [Otway wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/otway-wall-sconce/): A curved timber shell floating off a satin aluminium wall disc, hiding the globe and washing light up and down the wall. From $780.
- [Freycinet wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/freycinet-wall-sconce/): A small domed timber disc with a slip-cast ceramic hood. Quiet enough for a bedroom. From $460.
- [Barrington floor lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/barrington-floor-lamp/): A slender timber stem, a frosted opal globe and a soft sage steel base. From $1,950.
- [Karijini task lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/karijini-task-lamp/): A marri task lamp with a swivelling aluminium joint and a shallow turned timber shade. From $2,380.
- [Daylesford floor lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/daylesford-floor-lamp/): A turned timber dome shade on a slim sage powder-coated stem and base. From $1,420.
- [Bright cordless lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/bright-task-lamp/): A cordless lamp: a frosted opal glass cylinder on a turned timber base, for a desk, a bedside or the dinner table. From $420.
- [Lorne task lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/lorne-task-lamp/): A frosted glass mushroom shade on a raw terracotta collar and a turned timber base. From $680.
- [Myall candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/myall-candelabra/): A long tapering timber bar, lens-shaped in section, carrying a row of frosted opal globes over a dining table or kitchen island. From $2,450.
- [Coorong candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/coorong-candelabra/): Three spun shades in terracotta, sage and sand, hung from one timber canopy. From $1,980.
- [Kanangra candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/kanangra-candelabra/): Two slim timber rails carrying a row of seven frosted glass rods, for long tables and open-plan rooms. From $3,400.
